claim_cards.statement: HTTP GET is defined as a safe method: it should not have the significance of taking an action other than retrieval.
ISO 8601 calendar dates use year-month-day order, commonly written YYYY-MM-DD.
One million seconds is about 11.57 days; one billion seconds is about 31.7 years using 365-day years.
